category_definitions.B: SOURCE PRESENT / TEXT INCOMPLETE — source exists but complete checked searchable text is missing.
category_definitions.C: TEXT PRESENT / ORIGINAL NOT PUBLICLY EXPOSED — complete text exists but no publication-safe source image/PDF is exposed.
category_definitions.D: REGISTERED / PAGE INCOMPLETE — canonical event exists but one or more public presentation/link/live-verification conditions remain incomplete.
category_definitions.E: SOURCE_GAP — act/reference is evidenced or referenced but underlying official source is not recovered.
category_definitions.F: HISTORICAL RECOVERY — pre-2018/2011–2017 recovery lane requiring source-first work.
